results.title: ArriVent BioPharma Investigation Notice: Levi & Korsinsky Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into ArriVent BioPharma (AVBP)
results.description: AVBP shareholders are holding stock near a $12.09 52-week low after the Phase 3 FURVENT trial missed its primary endpoint, just five months after ArriVent launched a $250 million at-the-market stock offering.
